notes.title: Second Alpha Test for Untamed Ehizia starts September 13
notes.notes: [p]Adventurers! The world of Ehizia is opening for the second alpha test starting from September 13. You can sign up for the test by opening the Steam page and pressing “Request Access” next to Join the Untamed Ehizia Playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]For those who participated in the test in April this year, here are the highlights of the changes:[/p][p]    Added Steam Integration[/p][p]    Added new class Zealot and expanded Adventurer class (added more than 40 new skills)[/p][p]    Added six new in-game areas to explore, and now each area has unique new game mechanics.[/p][p]    Added Quest Journal to easily track all important talks with NPCs.[/p][p]    Added Quick Tutorial to help smoother start for new players.[/p][p]    Added Trade Boards that help to find fellow players to trade with.[/p][p]    Added Moderation Tools to help form a safe community for everyone.[/p][p]    Added multiple new quests, craft recipes, items, equipment, and mobs.[/p][p]    And lots of other improvements, including latency and performance improvements, and major rework on character control, UI, new Loot Pickup Preview system.[/p]
